description: This file is a unit test class for the ProjectActivityDao within the OrangeHRM Time plugin, specifically testing various CRUD operations and validation logic regarding project activities, including listing, retrieval, saving, copying, and deletion.
published: OrangeHRM	ests	imeepo	ests	estProjectActDao

classes.name: ProjectActivityDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ProjectActivityDao, covering creation, retrieval, update, deletion, duplication, and filtering of project activity entities within the OrangeHRM time management plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating a new instance of ProjectActivityDao and populating test data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of project activities filtered by project ID.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityListByFilterProjectActivityName
methods.description: Tests filtering project activities by project activity name.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific project activity by project ID and activity ID.

methods.name: testSaveProjectActivity
methods.description: Tests saving a new project activity to the database.

methods.name: testEditProjectActivity
methods.description: Tests updating an existing project activity.

methods.name: testExceptionForDeleteProjectActivity
methods.description: Ensures that an exception is thrown when attempting to delete project activities improperly.

methods.name: testDeleteProjectActivity
methods.description: Tests deletion of a project activity by ID.

methods.name: testDeleteProjectActivityNameValidation
methods.description: Validates the name uniqueness check for project activities.

methods.name: testGetDuplicatedActivityIds
methods.description: Tests detection of duplicated project activity entries.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivitiesByProjectIds
methods.description: Tests retrieval of multiple project activities by a list of IDs.

methods.name: testSaveCopyActivity
methods.description: Tests copying existing activities to another project.
